subject: Trial uplift request — weekend throughput soak for Shoplia POC
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom@shoplia.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick favor — weekend throughput soak (POC)

Hey Vanessa,

We’re ramping a Shoplia POC this Friday–Saturday to validate end-to-end latency at scale. The engineering team will run a 12-hour overnight soak with peaks around 2.5k concurrent requests (mostly short prompts, avg 120 tokens). Our current trial quota will be exhausted during the second hour.

Can Redwood provision a short-term credit uplift for the weekend so we can complete the soak? Quick details: 
- Window: Fri 2028-06-23 22:00 PDT — Sat 2028-06-24 10:00 PDT
- Expected tokens: ~260k total (with 20% headroom)
- Primary model: open-llama-13b-quant (lightweight seqs)

We need confirmation by EOD Thursday to update infra scripts. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Engineering, Shoplia
(attachment: shoplia-loadplan.xlsx)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@shoplia.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick favor — weekend throughput soak (POC)

Tom — thanks for the heads up and the load plan. I’ve looped in Rishi (solutions) and Marissa (CS) to size this safely. Two quick asks so we can make the approval fast:
1) Can you confirm whether you’ll use streaming responses or non-streaming? (streaming increases token usage slightly)
2) Do you need any temporary rate-limit increases during the 2–3 peak hours?

Tentatively we can approve a short-term uplift; Rishi — can you propose a cushion number and any model suggestions? Stephanie in billing will need the final amount to push the temporary credit.

I’ll hold this in my calendar to follow up after Rishi’s note.

— Vanessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | (attachment: internal-approval-note.txt)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom@shoplia.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick favor — weekend throughput soak (POC)

Vanessa / Tom — reviewed the load plan. Recommendations:
- Approve a 320k-token uplift (gives ~23% headroom vs Tom’s 260k)
- Set a temporary concurrency gate: 3k max to avoid noisy overloads on the endpoint
- Keep model pinned to the quantized variant; if you need lower latency, switch to the lower-latency 7b variant for the 2 peak hours (tradeoff: output quality vs latency)

Operational notes for the uplift:
- Start/End: we’ll set the uplift for 2028-06-23 21:00 PDT -> 2028-06-24 12:00 PDT to account for warmup/cooldown
- Billing: mark as promo uplift against DL-4821; temporary credit will be consumed and reported in the console

Stephanie — can billing provision a temporary promo credit token bucket of 320000 tokens tied to Shoplia (DL-4821)? If finance needs an authorization from Sales, I can sign off on the technical rationale.

Cheers,
Rishi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: rishi-ops-notes.txt)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick favor — weekend throughput soak (POC)

All — approved. Finance will apply a one-time promo credit of 320000 tokens to account Shoplia (DL-4821) with the following constraints:
- Effective window: 2028-06-23T21:00:00-07:00 through 2028-06-24T12:00:00-07:00
- Credit will be flagged in billing as "promo-topup-4821" and will not auto-renew
- We require a signed DocuSign acknowledgment for audit; I’ve attached the PDF to the thread.

Marissa — please confirm operational handoff (rate-limit settings) once the DocuSign is completed.

Stephanie Nguyen
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference

Tom — good news: we’ve provisioned a 320k-token promo uplift for your weekend soak. Summary below and next steps.

What we added
- Promo uplift: 320,000 tokens (label: promo-topup-4821)
- Active window: 2028-06-23 21:00 PDT -> 2028-06-24 12:00 PDT
- Operational safety: concurrency cap set to 3k for the endpoint; Rishi will monitor and can temporarily relax if needed.

Next steps for Shoplia
1) Please e-sign the DocuSign (link: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/Shoplia-topup-4821) — required for audit. (attachment: docusign-shoplia-topup.pdf)
2) Confirm whether you’ll switch to the 7b low-latency variant for hours 23:00–01:00 PDT or stick to the quantized 13b.
3) Send a quick Slack ping to Marissa when the soak starts; she’ll watch health metrics and escalate if we hit anomalies.

If anything changes, reply-all and we’ll adjust. Good luck with the soak — let us know how the latency curves look.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
